name: Zapier
shortDescription: Connects the apps you already use. The free plan includes 100 tasks per month.
longDescription: Zapier connects SaaS apps, including agent-style steps. On October 16, 2026 the pricing page listed Free at $0 with 100 tasks per month, and Professional starting from $19.99 per month.
pricingNotes: Re-open zapier.com/pricing in a browser to confirm free task limits before publishing.
bestFor: Connecting hosted apps without running a server
Teams that already live in Zapier’s app directory
strength: The free plan includes 100 tasks per month for connecting hosted apps without running a server.
weakness: Professional starts at $19.99 per month, and the workflows run on Zapier's cloud rather than a server you host.

useCaseFit.workflow-automation: Connects hosted apps, and the free plan includes 100 tasks per month.
